items.name: New York New Year: Farewell 2026
items.information: This competition is recognized as an official World Cube Association competition. Therefore, all competitors must be familiar with the WCA regulations. If you are new to competing, please refer to the Competition Procedures tab. Please note that this competition starts on the evening of December 31, 2026, extends past midnight into January 1, 2027, and ends around noon on January 2, 2027.

items.name: NxN New Year in Lugano 2026
items.information: **Italiano | Italian** La quota di iscrizione per questa competizione è di 20 CHF. Se decidi di registrarti anche a [Clock&FTO New Year in Lugano 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClockFTOinLugano2027), il prezzo combinato per entrambe le competizioni è di 30 CHF e il rimborso di 10 CHF verrà effettuato dopo la gara. **Deutsch | German** Die Anmeldegebühr für diesen Wettbewerb beträgt 20 CHF. Wenn du dich zusätzlich für [Clock&FTO New Year in Lugano 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClockFTOinLugano2027) anmeldest, beträgt der Gesamtpreis für beide Wettbewerbe 30 CHF und die 10 CHF bekommst du nach dem Wettbewerbe zurück **English** The registration fee for this competition is 20 CHF. If you also register for [Clock&FTO New Year in Lugano 2027](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/ClockFTOinLugano2027), the combined fee for both competitions is 30 CHF and the 10 CHF refund will be made after these competitions.
